name: Simply Organic Rubbed Dalmatian Sage
whyItWorks: Fluffy, velvety rubbed sage powder with zero sharp leaf shards. Imparts classic holiday roast turkey and comfort-food aroma to ground poultry or mashed potatoes without alliums.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dust over sautéed ground turkey, chicken meatballs, or butternut squash soup.
